results.title: Switching channels updates form input labels
results.preconditions: User is on /login page in guest state.
steps: Verify tel input field and Phone number label is displayed by default.
Click on the Email switch tab.
Verify email input field and Email address label is displayed.
results.expectedResult: Inputs and labels switch dynamically based on chosen channel.

results.title: Validation alerts are displayed for empty identifiers
results.preconditions: User is on /login page in guest state.
steps: Agree to Terms of Service by checking terms checkbox.
Click on the Send secure code button with empty identifier input.
results.expectedResult: Inline error text shows 'Enter your phone number to continue.'

results.title: Validation alerts are displayed for invalid formats
steps: Agree to terms.
Type 'abc' in phone field and submit. Verify format error.
Switch to Email, type 'invalid-email' in email field and submit. Verify format error.
results.expectedResult: Validation errors are displayed for incorrect formatting on phone and email.

results.title: Terms agreement gate blocks form submission
steps: Enter valid phone number.
Leave Terms agreement checkbox unchecked.
Click Send secure code button.
results.expectedResult: Error is displayed indicating Terms agreement is required, and form submission is blocked. Checkbox border turns red. Text error 'Please accept the Terms & Privacy Policy to continue.' should be displayed.
results.actualResult: Form submission is blocked and checkbox border turns red, but the actual text error message 'Please accept the Terms & Privacy Policy to continue.' is not rendered on screen (missing helperText property in Checkbox render).
consoleLogs: Error: Please accept the Terms & Privacy Policy to continue.

results.title: Happy path login redirects to OTP verification page
steps: Enter valid phone number.
Check Terms agreement checkbox.
Click Send secure code.
results.expectedResult: Redirects successfully to /verify-otp with masked destination number in state.
results.actualResult: Successfully navigated to /verify-otp showing phone mask '•••• 4567'.

results.title: OTP verification fails deterministic code 000000
steps: Enter code '000000' in OTP inputs.
Verify error text display after mock latency.
results.expectedResult: Error message displays 'Incorrect code. Please try again.'
results.actualResult: Incorrect code validation message correctly displayed.

results.title: OTP verification success redirects and establishes session
steps: Enter valid code '123456' in OTP inputs.
Verify success message and redirected transition.
results.expectedResult: Displays success visual state and redirects to loading.

results.title: Resend OTP cooldown timer and resend action
steps: Check that Resend button is disabled.
Verify countdown starts from 30s.
results.expectedResult: Resend code button remains disabled during cooldown.

results.title: RegisterPage submits and transitions to OTP
steps: Fill name, valid phone number, email.
Agree to consents and Privacy Policy checkboxes.
Click Create account button.
results.expectedResult: Navigates to /verify-otp with heading 'Verify your phone'.
results.actualResult: Successfully navigated to OTP page showing phone verification heading.

results.title: ForgotPasswordPage submits and shows success state
steps: Enter valid email format.
Click Send recovery instructions button.
results.expectedResult: Displays success notification screen with option to go back.

results.title: Social sign in buttons return unenabled warning
steps: Click on Google social sign-in button.
results.expectedResult: Shows error alert 'Social login is not enabled yet.'

results.title: Registration consent checkboxes validation text exposure
steps: Fill name and phone details.
Leave consent and privacy checkboxes unchecked.
Submit form.
results.expectedResult: Errors are displayed indicating consent and privacy agreements are required, and the actual error messages are rendered as helperText.
results.actualResult: Form submission is blocked, but no error text helper descriptions are shown to the user (missing helperText rendering on registration checkboxes).
